translations.web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
translations.bsb: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
translations.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness,
translations.asv: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
